title: Open a YouTube video's thumbnail
question: How do I see the full-size thumbnail of a YouTube video?
answer: YouTube has no button to open a video's thumbnail. The full-size image lives at i.ytimg.com/vi/VIDEO_ID/maxresdefault.jpg, where VIDEO_ID is the code after v= in the video's address, though some older videos only have hqdefault.jpg. The usermods script on this page adds a "View thumbnail" link under the title of every video that opens the largest thumbnail YouTube has for it in a new tab. Without an extension, type that address yourself.
prompt: Add a link under YouTube videos that opens the full-size thumbnail.
details: The script reads the thumbnail list the YouTube player already has for the current video and links to the last, largest entry, so it works for videos without a `maxresdefault` image too. The link sits under the title and updates when you open another video without a page reload. Nothing else on the page changes.

alternatives.title: Build the address by hand
alternatives.body: Take the video id from the address (`watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw`) and open `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/jNQXAC9IVRw/maxresdefault.jpg`. If that shows a grey placeholder, use `hqdefault.jpg` instead.
